mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservations ( id, inventory_id, checkout_id, order_id, order_item_id, quantity, status, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{inventoryId}, #{checkoutId}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, checkout_id, inventory_id, order_id, order_item_id, quantity, status FROM inventory_reservations WHERE checkout_id = #{checkoutId} ORDER BY inventory_id, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
